title: Overlapping scanner finding predicts Yes
description:
As a scanner engineer, I want the detector Score to return Yes when a finding overlaps a gold span, so that recall counts true detections.

Feature: Overlap is a detection

  Scenario: Overlapping finding is Yes
    Given a gold Item for a file and line span labeled Yes
    And the scanner emits a finding on that file with overlapping lines
    When I evaluate that Item
    Then the prediction is Yes

  Scenario: No overlapping finding is No
    Given a gold Item for a file the scanner did ingest
    And the scanner emits no finding overlapping that span
    When I evaluate that Item
    Then the prediction is No
    And the Item counts in the recall denominator

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Yes/No from file+line overlap. Landed with Plexus #613 and dataparade-cli #10/#11.
